entities.summary: Franklyn Atese Nubuasah S.V.D.,, also Frank Atese Nubuasah, is a Ghanaian-born Roman Catholic prelate who serves as the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Gaborone, Botswana since 2019. Before that, from 2 October 2017 until 6 June 2019 he was the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Francistown, Botswana. From 27 June 1998 until 9 August 2017 he worked as Apostolic Vicar of the Apostolic Vicariate of Francistown. From 9 August 2017 until 6 June 2019 he was the Apostolic Administrator of Gaborone, Botswana.
